concerns.text: Tasks T016 and T017 implement a 'concatenate-all' k-means strategy (clustering the full cohort matrix). This directly violates the Plan's architectural decision for 'Leave-One-Out (LOO) K-Means' (Section: Independence Enforcement Mechanism) and Constitution Principle VI (Structural-Functional Independence). The Plan explicitly states LOO is required to break circular dependency; the tasks silently relax this constraint to a simpler, invalid approach.

Tasks T040-T044 introduce a 'Tractography Noise Sensitivity' analysis (varying confidence thresholds). This scope is not authorized by any Functional Requirement in spec.md (which only mandates density thresholding sensitivity in FR-008) nor mentioned in the plan.md. This constitutes silent scope creep and a violation of the 'Scope Constraint' noted in the tasks notes, introducing unapproved implementation work.

Task T019 is marked as unchecked `[ ]` (incomplete) but is listed as a dependency for the 'Checkpoint' of Phase 3. The task list presents a false state of readiness for User Story 1, violating the requirement that tasks must accurately reflect the deliverable status required to satisfy the FR/SC.

Task T031 implements the sensitivity analysis using vague placeholder text ('A baseline TR value... A sensitivity check...') instead of explicitly mandating the 20 TR vs 30 TR comparison required by SC-002 and FR-006. This semantic weakening risks the deliverable failing to meet the specific acceptance criterion of calculating the 'absolute difference' between these specific windows.
